label: Decides through physics: MLP -> WaterSim HBV parameters, trained through the simulator
family_label: Differentiable simulator / physics in the loop
numpy_only_reason: The prediction IS a WaterSim run: predict.py maps attributes to parameters with a numpy MLP and then calls the harness's vendored WaterSim (numba-compiled HBV + degree-day snow + gamma channel UH + irrigation) through wsim.py. Re-writing WaterSim in numpy would duplicate the simulator the arm is meant to use.

compute.notes: One thread (process_time). torch-vs-WaterSim verification 25 s; two aborted pilot runs of the base (NSE* loss 336 s, log(1+NSE*) loss 558 s: both drove the volume bias to ~0.75); r0 0.745 h; r1 0.819 h; r2 0.425 h; band fitting + exports ~25 s. Harness evaluation ~1 min per rung.

feature_engineering: Network input: the 18-value static vector as given, standardised with the sim-train mean/sd. The simulator input: the batch forcing (P x the learned PMULT, PET from the forcing, T_mean) and a spec built from the attributes (area, elevation mean +- range/2 -> 5 equal-area bands, slope, irrigation share, lat/lon); spin-up = the 365 warm-up rows. Nothing else.
rule: keep if sim val median NSE > incumbent + 0.01 AND dev median NSE >= 0.95 x incumbent's (all 800 frozen sim val runs; 52 dev basins)

rungs.change: base: MLP 18-64-64-17 (SiLU) -> 17 HBV / degree-day snow / channel-velocity / P-multiplier parameters (sigmoid into WaterSim's bounds), trained through the torch copy of WaterSim (equal to 7e-14 mm/day) on sim-train windows (365 warm-up rows without gradient + 730 days), batch 64, Adam 2e-3 -> 1e-4 cosine, 2,000 iterations, bounded NSE loss x/(1+x) with x = NSE* per run
rungs.why: first rung (after two aborted pilots with NSE* and log(1+NSE*) losses)

rungs.change: loss = MSE of flow / p_mean (the forcing's mean P, an input): no per-run 1/variance weighting
rungs.why: sim val +0.060 (0.414 vs 0.354); dev 0.383 >= 0.95 x 0.365. The variance-normalised losses shrank volumes (median bias 0.75) because dry runs weigh most; the input-scaled MSE keeps volumes (bias ~1)

rungs.change: warm start from r1, effective batch 128 (2 x 64 accumulated), Adam 3e-4 -> 3e-5, 500 more iterations
